about: The drawing tables of the scenario sampler, version 1 (specs/scenario-sampler.md). 'pairs' and 'nearMiss' copy SCHEME.md section 9 (a test checks they match it); the rest are drawing choices in English, never wording and never a statement of the law. Amounts are in dinars. Written 15 November 2026.

facts: the other party is a commune, sued over the same facts
the other party is a ministry's local directorate, sued over the same facts
the other party is a wilaya, sued over the same facts
the other party is a public institution of an administrative character, sued over the same facts
the note asks to annul a decision of an administration
the client wants to file a criminal complaint instead of a civil claim
the client wants to join the criminal case already opened as a civil party
the client wants an order to pay from the court president on written proof, not a claim
the note asks for an order to pay (a payment order), not a full claim
the client asks the judge of urgent matters for a provisional measure only
the note asks for an urgent provisional order pending the main case
a final judgment already exists and the client wants it enforced
the note asks to have an existing final judgment carried out
the matter is the share of an inheritance
the matter is a kafala of a child
the matter is proof of a marriage that was never registered
the matter is proof of descent of a child
the matter is the guardianship of an adult relative
the note asks to correct a name in a birth record
the note asks to correct a date in a civil-status record
the matter is the partition of a jointly owned house
the matter is the boundary between two plots
the matter is a right of pre-emption on a sold share
the matter is protecting possession of a plot
the dispute is between partners of a company over its management
the note asks to dissolve the company the parties founded together
the matter is a dispute between neighbours over noise, outside every listed kind of claim
the matter is the return of a deposit paid for a cancelled wedding hall booking, outside every listed kind of claim

informalDemand: the client only asked for payment by word of mouth
the client reminded the other side by telephone
the client sent a text message as a reminder
the client sent an ordinary letter that only reminds and asks, without calling it a notice

noticeForm.bailiff: a formal notice served by a bailiff
noticeForm.registered_letter: a formal notice sent by registered letter, which the note itself calls a notice
noticeForm.other: a formal notice delivered by hand against a signature, which the note itself calls a notice
noticeForm.unknown: a formal notice, without saying how it was sent

publicBodies: a public institution of an administrative character in {place} (say that character)
the local directorate of a ministry in {place}
publicBodyUnclear: a body the note calls only «a public institution», with nothing more
a body the note calls only «an institution», with nothing more
publicCompany: a public economic company (say it is a public company of an economic character)

any: the client is tired of waiting and wants the case filed quickly
the client asks whether the hearing can be held in the afternoon
the client first went to another lawyer, who did not take the case
the client's cousin knows the other side from the neighbourhood
the client keeps all the papers in a blue folder
civil: the other side recently changed his telephone number
a neighbour witnessed some of the exchanges
commercial: both firms have done business together for years
the defendant's manager changed last year
family: the children attend the primary school of the district
the grandmother helps with the children after school
labour: the worker had a good record and no warning
the worker was a member of the works committee

unrelatedAmounts: the fee the client paid for copies of documents
the value of a car the client owns, mentioned in passing
the client's monthly rent for his own flat
the price of the client's new telephone, mentioned in passing
